tasks.title: Bounded collection rendering and stable request identities
acceptance: 10,004-request fixture supports full search and keyboard navigation with bounded viewport rows
Filter and selection meet recorded reference budgets

tasks.title: Workspace path and canonical-read integrity
acceptance: Reject symlink/redirection and changed directory identities without rewriting files
Bound descriptor reads and preserve oversized or malformed resources

tasks.title: Single-writer lease and explicit exited-owner recovery
acceptance: Competing cooperating writers are refused before initialization
Reviewed-token recovery preserves workspace data; live/unknown owners are refused

tasks.title: External-file reconciliation and conflict context review
acceptance: Clean resources reconcile; dirty/busy drafts survive external edits/deletions
Explicit choices recheck disk revision; stale Send/Run is rejected before transport

tasks.title: Versioned workspace repository and storage ADR
acceptance: One repository owns canonical collection/environment/request commits across callers
ADR defines versioned manifest, per-request files, commit point, revisions and recovery
Per-request edits produce isolated reviewable file diffs and preserve opaque imported fields

tasks.title: Migration dry-run, backup and validated restore
acceptance: Preflight validates schemas/IDs/paths/checksums and reports changes without writes
Migration retains a backup and resumes or rolls back interrupted commits
Restore verifies checksums/schema and refuses stale or unreviewed destructive changes
Fault-injected restart and round-trip fixtures show no silent loss; tests use disposable roots

tasks.title: Complete collection and folder authoring
acceptance: Create/rename/duplicate/delete collections and nested folders with stable IDs
Move/reorder requests and folders with cycle/depth/identity validation
Collection/folder inherited auth, variables and scripts are editable and affect actual execution
Revision conflicts and failed writes retain drafts; keyboard users can invoke every action

tasks.title: Complete request authoring and identity-safe edits
acceptance: Create/rename/duplicate/delete/move/reorder requests inside folders
Duplication creates fresh identities while preserving editable content and opaque metadata
Pending operations cannot discard newer or unrelated drafts

tasks.title: Multiple request tabs and response ownership
acceptance: Open/switch/close independent request tabs; dirty close requires an explicit choice
Late save/execution results update only their owning tab
Execution cancellation and bounded tab/response retention are visible and tested

tasks.title: Bounded request history, examples and undo
acceptance: History has declared count/byte retention and no automatic replay
Users can inspect/reopen requests and save examples with explicit secret exclusion
Undo/recovery choices preserve identities and never overwrite a newer revision

tasks.title: Durable draft and restart recovery
acceptance: Committed recoveries survive reload/restart independently of canonical saves
Recovery retains the original revision/context and requires review when disk changed or vanished
Concurrent tabs do not overwrite one another; failed/quota writes are visible
Retention, local storage/privacy behavior and explicit discard are documented and testable

tasks.title: Import corpus and semantic migration reports
acceptance: Sanitized Postman v2.1/cURL fixtures cover nested inheritance, repeated/disabled values and unsupported fields
Import/export/restart preserves opaque metadata and reports semantic differences
Unsupported schemas/modes fail explicitly; v3 YAML remains P7

tasks.title: Environment editing and scope diagnostics
acceptance: Environment CRUD/revision behavior and inherited scope explanations are tested
Plaintext/reference limitations are explicit; keychain implementation stays in P2
Failed/conflicting environment saves cannot silently change execution context

tasks.title: P1 acceptance and phase handoff
acceptance: All P1 deliverables have post-change automated and public browser evidence
Package/extension builds and regression suite pass; large-list budget is remeasured after UI changes
P1 progress and requirement dispositions name remaining cross-phase work without overstating parity

tasks.title: Secure credential lifecycle
acceptance: Keychain providers fail closed/session-only; migration/export consent and recovery are explicit
OAuth provider fixtures cover PKCE/state/callback/denial/refresh rotation and concurrent refresh

tasks.title: HTTP completion and transport settings
acceptance: Exact repeated fields, file selection, cancellation, redirects, cookies, binary download and streaming budgets are verified
mTLS/custom CA fixtures preserve default TLS verification

tasks.title: P2 acceptance gate
acceptance: Supported auth/secret/HTTP subset documented with real provider and wire fixtures; no seeded credentials leak

tasks.title: Versioned script and Send/Run policy
acceptance: Pinned reference differential cases compare event order, typed precedence/mutation, wire bytes and errors

tasks.title: Worker and destination-policy enforcement
acceptance: Bounded worker queue/bridge and adversarial script cancellation release resources
Workspace grants apply to direct, redirected and script-originated network calls

tasks.title: Durable CI jobs and reports
acceptance: Durable results are bounded/redacted and never silently rerun destructive work after restart
Actual CLI/MCP clients verify cancellation, denial, stable exit codes and reports

tasks.title: P3 acceptance gate
acceptance: Declared compatibility subset passes pinned differential suite and public negative paths

tasks.title: Capture sessions and reviewed evidence
acceptance: Filters/retention/selection preserve immutable sanitized observations and provenance

tasks.title: Reviewed contract and regression pipeline
acceptance: Independent OpenAPI validation; observed/inferred/confirmed distinctions remain visible
Approved fixture replay catches seeded contract drift and client failures

tasks.title: Executable generated clients and snippets
acceptance: Generated outputs compile and execute auth/path/body/error/binary/cancel fixture cases

tasks.title: P4 acceptance gate
acceptance: Capture → review → contract → fixture → generated client succeeds without seeded-secret disclosure

tasks.title: Install, onboarding and supported platform matrix
acceptance: Clean supported OS installs exercise restart/upgrade/rollback with actionable doctor diagnostics
Actual installed VS Code extension host and real MCP clients verify supported operations

tasks.title: Independent security and accessibility review
acceptance: Independent review scope/findings/disposition recorded; no release-blocking security/data-loss findings
Keyboard/accessibility/mobile/browser checks have recorded outcomes and manual review

tasks.title: Representative performance and target-user validation
acceptance: Record process-tree RSS, startup/interaction/resource/load methodology and limits
At least ten independent target developers attempt the supported task chain; investigate every loss event
Repeat use over multiple weeks and proposed 90% task target are evaluated

tasks.title: Stable local release decision
acceptance: P0–P4 gates and P5 evidence pass; support/compatibility/license/upgrade policies are published
External reviews, credentials and trials are real prerequisites, never self-awarded

tasks.title: Shared protocol/event contracts
acceptance: At least two real adapters establish connect/send/subscribe/cancel and bounded events without HTTP-only assumptions

tasks.title: Protocol peer and reconnect acceptance
acceptance: GraphQL, WebSocket/Socket.IO and SSE real peers cover auth, framing, cancellation, backpressure and reconnect duplication

tasks.title: P6 release gate
acceptance: Per-surface capability tables and unsupported protocol features match integration evidence

tasks.title: Demand-ranked protocol and auth releases

tasks.title: Consented browser/native capture
acceptance: Domain grants, recording indication and stop/revoke behavior verified; no background capture/upload
TLS interception requires its own trust design and explicit manual certificate installation

tasks.title: Interoperability evaluation
acceptance: Native v3 YAML is evaluated as a separate parser/serializer; internal schema remains explicit

tasks.title: P7 release gates
acceptance: Each independent capability has real peer/signing-vector/format fixtures and documented limitations

tasks.title: Local lifecycle tools
acceptance: Mocks isolate state/files/network; docs/examples exclude secrets; SDK publishing follows runtime correctness

tasks.title: Durable scheduling and load integration
acceptance: Timezone/missed-run/duplicate/alert-spam tests; external load adapter identifies generator limits
Retries and mixed-protocol runs use the shared job/event engine

tasks.title: Optional scripted UI extensions
acceptance: Approved package libraries, sandboxed visualizers and visual workflows cannot bypass execution policy

tasks.title: P8 release gates
acceptance: Independent demand-ranked increments have public functional, isolation and resource evidence

tasks.title: Self-hosted platform scope and threat model
acceptance: Define operators, authentication boundary, tenant model, retention and operational budget before shared deployment

tasks.title: Durable collaborative platform
acceptance: Every resource/job checks server-side authorization; users/orgs/invitations/revocation/RBAC/tenant isolation tested
Sync/fork/review conflicts preserve concurrent work; durable jobs never silently replay side effects

tasks.title: Self-hosted operations and recovery
acceptance: Backup/restore, TLS, queues, incident/upgrade/runbook and cost/abuse controls verified

tasks.title: P9 release gates
acceptance: Real multi-user isolation/revocation/recovery tests and operational evidence pass

tasks.title: Funded enterprise scope decision
acceptance: Explicit demand, scope, security owners and funding precede execution

tasks.title: Identity, governance and vault integration
acceptance: Real SSO/OIDC/SAML/SCIM provider fixtures validate lifecycle and revocation
Audit integrity/retention, external vaults and encryption administration have reviewed threat models

tasks.title: Private runners and opt-in AI/context
acceptance: Runner isolation and egress grants enforced; model costs/privacy and explicit opt-in documented

tasks.title: P10 release gates
acceptance: Enterprise capabilities meet scoped conformance/operations evidence; no unearned certification claim

tasks.title: Resolve large-workspace event-to-frame outliers
acceptance: Investigate retained p95 failures with synchronous-work and frame-scheduling measurements; do not discard slow samples or attribute a cause from focus alone
Meet the existing 100 ms filter/selection event-to-frame budget on the documented supported reference setup
Record source hashes, browser/control methodology and raw samples before closing the performance gate

tasks.title: OS credential providers and session-only lifecycle
acceptance: Secret values use the selected OS secure provider or explicit session-only storage; no plaintext fallback or process-argument exposure
Provider refusal, restart/missing session state, typed purpose and per-origin isolation are exercised

tasks.title: Secret references, consent migration and safe exports
acceptance: References resolve only for approved actual destinations after scripts/variables; resolved credential values are never automatically saved as plaintext
Reviewed migration rechecks revisions and preserves recoverable source on failures
Exports/backups/reports omit resolved values and require explicit consent for inline plaintext credentials

tasks.title: OAuth acquisition and owned callbacks
acceptance: Authorization code with PKCE/state/nonce and client credentials use maintained standards implementation
Real fake-provider fixtures cover success, denial, wrong state/callback, replay, timeout and secure-store refusal

tasks.title: OAuth expiry, refresh rotation and clear/revoke
acceptance: Expired/rotated tokens refresh once under concurrent calls and update an atomic secure bundle
Refresh failure retains recoverable account state; clearing local state and remote revocation are explicit and tested

tasks.title: Selected multipart and binary streaming uploads
acceptance: Only explicitly chosen bytes are uploaded with bounded private session file capabilities
Real wire byte equality, multipart field order, import-path refusal and cancellation/limit cleanup are tested

tasks.title: HTTP wire fidelity, cookies and diagnostics
acceptance: Repeated fields/method/encoding/redirect/deadline cases are verified against real peers
Cookie editing, clear, domain/path/secure behavior and explicit secure persistence are tested
Diagnostics explain observed failures without unsupported timing or secret leakage

tasks.title: Verified TLS, custom CA and mutual TLS
acceptance: Default certificate and hostname verification stays enabled; unknown/bypass settings fail explicitly
mTLS fails without the selected key/certificate and succeeds with them; custom CA and cross-origin credential boundaries are exercised

tasks.title: Bounded streamed responses and exact downloads
acceptance: Progress/preview/download preserve owner identity with explicit preview/artifact limits and backpressure
Larger binary/media types, compressed expansion, abort/disconnect and retention cleanup are verified

tasks.title: Schema-aware authoring and credential/HTTP workflows
acceptance: JSON syntax and supported schemas validate with bounded off-main-thread execution and no remote schema fetch
Public browser credential/OAuth/file/TLS/cookie/streaming controls use explicit consent and retain failed inputs
Sensitive inputs, reviewed examples and inspector/export flows exclude seeded secret values

update_rules: Update this JSON in the same change as implementation status/evidence; regenerate TASK_TRACKER.md.
A done task needs acceptance evidence after its last relevant mutation. Historical evidence must be named as historical.
Do not mark a broad PACKETLARK requirement accepted from a partial increment or from its old current_status label.
A phase closes only when its tasks, scoped requirement dispositions and phase gate are verified.
Newly discovered work receives a stable task ID and requirement link; do not silently drop or renumber tasks.
Counts measure tasks, not effort; do not turn them into a product readiness percentage.
